notes.title: Two Bad Fellas 1.3
notes.content:
Update: Improved Gameplay & Fixes!

Hey everyone! We've made some important improvements to Two Bad Fellas:

Now, when you get caught by the Two Bad Fellas, the game no longer restarts from the main menu but from the initial room.
Pressing ESC now opens the general settings menu.
Various bugs have been fixed to improve the overall experience.
Keep playing and let us know what you think!
